name: fitness-guide-monorepo
description: 健身指南：默认中文的本地优先个人健身 App，内置中英切换与 SVG 动作库。

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @bryllim/workout-guide run build && pnpm --filter fitness-guide-site run build
scripts.check: pnpm run catalog:validate && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm test && pnpm run build
scripts.sites:build: SITE_BASE=/ pnpm --filter @bryllim/workout-guide run build && SITE_BASE=/ pnpm --filter fitness-guide-site run build:sites && node scripts/prepare-sites-output.mjs
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @bryllim/workout-guide run build && pnpm --filter fitness-guide-site run typecheck
